description: Lists the ten everyday jobs in Agent Blueprint's measured agent cost benchmark (2 November 2026): what each job was, how big its input was, and the typical and worst-case tokens and dollar cost measured over five runs each on Claude Code and Codex. Use it to find the benchmark job closest to a task someone wants an agent to do, before estimating that task's cost.

agent.description: Only show one agent's measurements. Leave out to show both.
